subproblem.title: Cylinder current X ↦ X ∘ S from the bounded-current constructor, with mass bound and additivity
subproblem.statement: Notation: ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} for t ∈ ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^N; Jv := ι(0, v) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v)); e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{N+1}; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) := TestFormOn univ m and 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) := GeometricCurrentOn univ m (forms and currents on all of ℝ^P = Euclid P); M(T) := T.mass = T.massOn univ; spt T := T.support. Assume (MSB): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with M(X) < ∞, ψ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) and c ∈ ℝ with |ψ(x)| ≤ c for every x ∈ spt X, one has |X(ψ)| ≤ c·M(X).toReal; and (BC): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, every ℝ-linear T₀ : 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) → ℝ and C ∈ ℝ such that |T₀(ω)| ≤ C·c whenever ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N), c ∈ ℝ and |ω(x)| ≤ c for all x, there is T ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with T(ω) = T₀(ω) for all ω and M(T) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C. Then for all N, k ∈ ℕ and every ℝ-linear S : 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) → 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) satisfying (iii) [for every ω and c ∈ ℝ with |ω(y)| ≤ c for all y ∈ ℝ^{N+1}, |S(ω)(x)| ≤ c for all x ∈ ℝ^N], there is a map cyl : 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) such that (a) for every X with M(X) < ∞: cyl(X)(ω) = X(S(ω)) for all ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and M(cyl(X)) ≤ M(X); (b) cyl(X − Y) = cyl(X) − cyl(Y) for all X, Y ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with M(X) < ∞ and M(Y) < ∞ (X − Y is the difference of currents of the frozen contract).
subproblem.lean_statement: (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), X.mass < ∞ → (∀ x ∈ X.support, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |X ψ| ≤ c * X.mass.toReal) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (T₀ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |T₀ ω| ≤ C * c) → ∃ T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ ω, T ω = T₀ ω) ∧ T.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C) → ∀ (N k : ℕ) (S : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (c : ℝ), (∀ y : Euclid (N + 1), covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) y) ≤ c) → ∀ x : Euclid N, covectorEuclideanNorm ((S ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → ∃ cyl : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, X.mass < ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), cyl X ω = X (S ω)) ∧ (cyl X).mass ≤ X.mass) ∧ ∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, X.mass < ∞ → Y.mass < ∞ → cyl (X - Y) = cyl X - cyl Y
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps 3, 5 and 6 of the parent proof. Fix N, k and a linear S with property (iii).
1. The bounded functional. Let X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with M(X) < ∞, and let T₀ := X.toCurrent ∘ S, i.e. T₀(ω) = X(S(ω)); T₀ is ℝ-linear as a composite of linear maps. Let ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and c ∈ ℝ with |ω(y)| ≤ c for all y. By (iii), |S(ω)(x)| ≤ c for all x ∈ ℝ^N, in particular for all x ∈ spt X, so (MSB) with dimension N, degree k and ψ := S(ω) gives |T₀(ω)| = |X(S(ω))| ≤ c·M(X).toReal = M(X).toReal·c.
2. Construction. By (BC) in dimension N + 1 and degree k + 1, applied to T₀ and C := M(X).toReal, there is T_X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) with T_X(ω) = X(S(ω)) for all ω and M(T_X) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(M(X).toReal) = M(X) (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal, since M(X) ≠ ∞).
3. Definition of cyl. Using classical choice, put cyl(X) := T_X (the current chosen in step 2) if M(X) < ∞, and cyl(X) := 0 otherwise. Then for every X with M(X) < ∞ we have cyl(X)(ω) = X(S(ω)) for all ω and M(cyl(X)) ≤ M(X). This is (a).
4. Finite mass of differences. Let M(X) < ∞ and M(Y) < ∞. By definition, M(X − Y) is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal((X − Y)(ω)) over the admissible ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N), i.e. tsupport ω ⊆ univ and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x. For such ω, (X − Y)(ω) = X(ω) − Y(ω) (the difference of currents acts by the difference of the underlying linear functionals), and (MSB) with c = 1 gives |X(ω)| ≤ M(X).toReal and |Y(ω)| ≤ M(Y).toReal. Hence ENNReal.ofReal((X − Y)(ω)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(M(X).toReal + M(Y).toReal), and taking the supremum (sSup_le), M(X − Y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(M(X).toReal + M(Y).toReal) < ∞ (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top). This is the parent's bound M(X − Y) ≤ M(X) + M(Y), obtained here through (MSB).
5. Additivity (b). Let M(X) < ∞ and M(Y) < ∞. By step 4, (a) applies to X − Y as well as to X and Y. So for every ω, cyl(X − Y)(ω) = (X − Y)(S(ω)) = X(S(ω)) − Y(S(ω)) = cyl(X)(ω) − cyl(Y)(ω) = (cyl(X) − cyl(Y))(ω). Two currents with the same value on every test form are equal (GeometricCurrentOn.ext), so cyl(X − Y) = cyl(X) − cyl(Y). □
proof_key_steps: For M(X) < ∞, T₀ := X ∘ S is linear and |T₀(ω)| ≤ M(X).toReal·c whenever |ω| ≤ c, by (iii) and (MSB).
(BC) yields T_X with T_X(ω) = X(S(ω)) and M(T_X) ≤ ofReal(M(X).toReal) = M(X).
cyl(X) := T_X if M(X) < ∞, else 0; this gives (a).
M(X − Y) < ∞ by (MSB) with c = 1 on admissible forms; then cyl(X − Y) = cyl(X) − cyl(Y) by evaluation on every ω and GeometricCurrentOn.ext.
